Class SemanticMemoryExecutor

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.memory.executor.AbstractMemoryExecutor
tech.kayys.wayang.memory.SemanticMemoryExecutor
All Implemented Interfaces:
tech.kayys.gamelan.engine.plugin.GamelanPlugin, tech.kayys.gamelan.plugin.executor.ExecutorPlugin
@ApplicationScoped @Executor(executorType="semantic-memory-executor", communicationType=GRPC, maxConcurrentTasks=30, supportedNodeTypes={"semantic-memory","semantic-memory-task","knowledge-memory","concept-memory"}, version="1.0.0") public class SemanticMemoryExecutor extends AbstractMemoryExecutor
Semantic memory executor for storing and retrieving factual knowledge and concepts. Optimized for general knowledge, definitions, relationships, and conceptual understanding. Supports knowledge graph-like queries and concept linking.
